label: Heading
_notes:
'title' is inline_richtext and must NOT be wrapped in

tags. heading_size: h0 = largest, h3 = smallest. Real schema also has a 'custom' heading_size value backed by separate custom_desktop_size/custom_mobile_size number fields — omitted here since those size fields aren't exposed, so never emit 'custom'. All remaining real settings (alignment, custom text color, the two 'highlight' word-styling systems, and an extensive scroll/typing/shiny text-animation system) are pure visual styling/animation, omitted.
